title: Large Language Models and Thematic Analysis: Human-AI Synergy in Researching Hate Speech on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating GPT-4's capability to perform inductive and deductive thematic analysis on a dataset of YouTube comments containing hate speech, stereotypes, and prejudice against Roma migrants, and comparing its categorizations with human expert analysis to assess its ability to identify racist discourse.

Analyzing how the language model categorizes social media discourse around immigration, welfare debates, and cultural clashes, specifically assessing its ability to correctly classify nativist and populist sentiments compared to human researchers.
